meaning.en: Something that seduces or has the qualities to seduce; an enticement.
meaning.vi: Một thứ gì đó quyến rũ hoặc có những phẩm chất để quyến rũ; một lời dụ dỗ.

meaning.en: The act of seducing or the state of being seduced.
meaning.vi: Hành động dụ dỗ hoặc trạng thái bị dụ dỗ.
Một cái gì đó mà quyến rũ.

meaning.en: (dated, law, in English common law) The felony of, as a man, inducing a previously chaste unmarried female to engage in sexual intercourse on a promise of marriage.
meaning.vi: (ngày, luật, trong thông luật của Anh) Trọng tội của một người đàn ông, khiến một người phụ nữ chưa kết hôn trước đây trong trắng giao cấu với một lời hứa kết hôn.

meaning_vi: sự quyến rũ, sự dụ dỗ, sự cám dỗ

sentences.en: Aside from the personals, Grrl2Grrl includes chat rooms, "confessions", and specialized activities for members such as the "Appetite for Seduction" or "Dare 2 Share" which lets lesbians share their coming out stories with each other.

sentences.en: Although Andronicus was at that time fifty-six years old, age had not diminished his charms, and Theodora became the next victim of his artful seduction.

sentences.en: Their mother and the regent's, her father's former mistress, was herself not impervious to her prisoner's lifelong power of seduction and subjugation.

sentences.en: Becoming also tutor to the maiden, he used the unlimited power which he thus obtained over her for the purpose of seduction, though not without cherishing a real affection which she returned in unparalleled devotion.

sentences.en: He far exceeded all other statesmen in the art of drawing together, without the seduction of self-interest, the concurrence and co-operation of various dispositions and abilities of men, whom he assimilated to his character and associated in his labours."

sentences.en: One of the rare female Guardians, Jenn was tall and willowy with dark hair and green eyes, a studied air of seduction, and the ability to penetrate any group he sent her after.

sentences.en: Focusing hard on not letting him affect her, she continued her game of seduction, teasing him with looks, touches, whispers, until Darian's body was rigid and his turmoil had melted into lust intense enough to make his eyes glow.
sentences.vi: Tập trung hết sức vào việc không để anh ảnh hưởng đến mình, cô tiếp tục trò chơi quyến rũ, trêu chọc anh bằng ánh nhìn, động chạm, thì thầm, cho đến khi cơ thể Darian cứng ngắc và sự rối loạn của anh tan thành dục vọng mãnh liệt đến mức khiến anh sáng mắt.
